question: Veer starts from Point Y and drives 34 km towards north. He then takes a left turn, drives 20 km. He then turns left and drives 40 km. He takes a final left turn, drives 20 km and stops at Point Z. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point Y again? (All turns are 90° turns only unless specified.)
solution:
Given: 

Veer starts from Point Y and drives 34 km towards north.

He then takes a left turn, drives 20 km.

He then turns left and drives 40 km.

He takes a final left turn, drives 20 km and stops at Point Z.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/399f5da1561597bf199a3dcc263a59d2b35b53d7c289d8344a34bcba9b146a42.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/afd518de57bce401b23ffe0f9038244cad39b5029adcbd73f19a305718e667b7.png] 

So, Veer must cover the 6 km distance by driving 6 km towards the North.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
